name: Review pull requests in GitHub Actions

pr.title: Announce no unreviewed head that GitHub Actions reviews
pr.head: c477c7392eb9ca8a36e50fcd8128eb9f67f2a6af

summary: The watch daemon is the background process that polls GitHub for each pull request a session subscribes to and tells that session what changed, as one-line events. One event, UNREVIEWED, goes to the session that fixes a pull request. It says the pull request is ready for review, its head is not signed off, and the daemon can see no review running.

A repository can also have its pull requests reviewed by a GitHub Actions job, which project init --ci-review sets up and records as review.ci = true in .projector.toml. In such a repository, UNREVIEWED fired when it should not. While the job waits in the queue there is no start comment yet. After a review that requests changes, the start comment is gone and the head is still not signed off. So the fixer heard that nobody reviewed the pull request even though the workflow does.

This change makes the daemon hold UNREVIEWED back for a head from the repository's own branches when review.ci is true. A failed CI review already arrives as a failed check through the CHECKS event, so nothing is lost. A fork's pull request still gets the notice, because the review workflow skips forks.

cards.title: Terms
cards.html:
• Live checkout: a checkout of the repository that a running agent session works in. The daemon reads repository settings only from one of these.
  • Pass: one round of the daemon's polling, which reads each live checkout's settings once.
  • Fork head: a pull request whose head branch lives in another repository, which GitHub reports as isCrossRepository.

groups.title: The daemon's decision
groups.kicker: Reading review.ci with review.reviewers, and asking GitHub whether a head is a fork
intro: The daemon already read review.reviewers from each live checkout once a pass, to know which accounts' verdicts count. This change reads review.ci in the same loop, so each checkout's configuration is loaded once, and keeps both in one table keyed by repository.

route_fix, which decides the events a fixing session hears, now skips UNREVIEWED when reviewed_in_ci says GitHub Actions reviews the head. To tell a fork's head apart, the daemon's GraphQL query for each pull request now asks for isCrossRepository.

checks.text: The rule matches .github/workflows/projector-review.yml, whose review job runs on every non-draft pull request whose head is in the repository, including one marked ready later. UNREVIEWED already ignores drafts.

files.note: settings_of replaces the reviewers-only lookup, reviewed_in_ci is the new test, and route_fix calls it beside the other reasons to hold the notice back.

checks.text: The query result is cached on disk between full queries. An entry cached by an older release lacks isCrossRepository, so it reads as a same-repository head, which can hold back a fork's notice once after an upgrade, until the next full query, at most watch.full_every (600 seconds).
One try covers both settings, so a mistyped review.ci, such as the string "true", raises ConfigError and drops that repository's review.reviewers as well. The review lists this as a suggestion.
Every caller of the old Pass.logins table goes through counted_logins, which now reads settings_of; a search of src/ finds no other reader.

groups.title: Test and documentation
groups.kicker: One pass over an own-branch and a fork pull request, and the two reference rows
intro: The test sets up a live checkout whose .projector.toml sets review.ci = true, then runs a pass over two ready pull requests: one from the repository's own branch and one from a fork. It expects the notice for the fork only. The fake GitHub now sets isCrossRepository on every pull request from whether the test named a fork.
The reference rows for review.ci and UNREVIEWED in docs/cli.md now say the daemon reads the setting and when the notice is held back.

checks.text: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest tests.test_watch ran 159 tests, OK, at this head, and the review's gate passed.
skills/fix-pr/SKILL.md lists the cases that hold UNREVIEWED back and does not name review.ci yet. The review lists this as a suggestion.

files.note: The new test fails if the daemon ignores review.ci, because both pull requests would get the notice, and fails if it ignores forks, because neither would.

checks.text: Every fake pull request now carries isCrossRepository, so the existing tests run against the field too.
